ARPITHA B T

OBJECTIVE

Secure a responsible career opportunity to fully utilize my skills and abilities, while making a significant contribution to the success of the company and advancing my own professional success.

EXPERIENCE

FRONTEND DEVELOPER

VIVID INNOVATION PRIVATE LIMITED	| JUNE 2024 - NOW

 Skilled in developing and maintaining responsive web applications using Angular, HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.

 Created reusable components, integrated RESTful APIs, and implemented responsive designs. Optimized performance, debugged issues, and delivered user- friendly solutions while adhering to modern development practices. Explored and applied new technologies to enhance project outcomes.

PROJECTS

 Gruppie Campus Connect (GC2): Working as a Web Developer on Gruppie Campus Connect (GC2), a digital platform that streamlines academic and administrative processes for educational institutions. The project covers the entire student lifecycle with modules like admission, attendance, fee management, and communication. My role involves building responsive UI components using Angular 17, integrating RESTful APIs, and enhancing overall user experience.

	API Tracking System: Developed an API tracking application to systematically maintain records of all APIs

created within the project.

Captured and logged essential details including endpoint URL, request body, response data, status codes, and timestamps.

Designed a user-friendly interface to view and search API records for better traceability and debugging.

CERTIFICATION

	Python-Certified Python Data Analyst Training at Besant Technologies, Hebbal, Bangalore, Karnataka-560061.

	Web Development Training by LinkedIn learning.

HOBBIES

Watching Movies Listening Music Doing Yoga

 Travelling

DECLARATION

I certify and declare that. the above information provided is true to the best of my knowledge and belief. This Bio-Data correctly describes My Qualification and Myself.

Date:	Arpitha B T
